documents.title: Experiment Log
documents.lead: Dated experiments with exact identities, execution evidence, results, failures, limits, and decisions.
documents.policy: Append every completed or materially changed experiment; archive superseded detail when the active method identity changes.

documents.title: 实验日志
documents.lead: 按日期记录实验身份、执行证据、结果、失败、边界与决定。
documents.policy: 每项已完成或发生重要变化的实验都要追加；当前方法身份变化时归档已失效的详细内容。
